chapterInfo.content:
28
Nhyira ne nnome
1Abɔnefoɔ dwane berɛ obi mpamo wɔn,
na teneneefoɔ deɛ, wɔyɛ nnam sɛ gyataburuwa.
2Asase mmarato na ɛma ɛso ahemfo dɔɔso,
na nnipa nhunumufoɔ ne nimdefoɔ
na ɛma ɔhene kyɛreɛ.
3Ohiani a ɔhyɛ ohiani soɔ
te sɛ osuo a ɛpra adeɛ korɔ a ɛmma aduane mma.
4 # Dwom 49.13 Wɔn a wɔgya mmara no yi ɔbɔnefoɔ ayɛ,
na wɔn a wɔdi mmara soɔ no ne wɔn di aperepereɛ.
5Nnipa bɔne nhunu atemmuo mu,
na wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ AWURADE akyiri kwan no hunu ade nyinaa mu.
6 # Mmb 19.1 Ohiani a ɔnam ne pɛyɛ mu yɛ
sene deɛ ɔkyea akwan mmienu mu na wanya ne ho.
7Deɛ ɔbu mmara no yɛ ɔba nyansafoɔ,
na deɛ ɔne ahohwifoɔ bɔ no hyɛ n’agya aniwuo.
8 # Mmb 13.22 Deɛ ɔde mfɛntom ne apempensie dɔre n’adeɛ no,
ɔboaboa ano ma deɛ ɔbɛhunu mmɔborɔfoɔ mmɔborɔ.
9 # Mmb 21.27 Deɛ ɔyi n’aso firi mmara tie ho no,
ne mpaebɔ mpo yɛ akyiwadeɛ.
10Deɛ ɔgyegye teefoɔ kɔ bɔne kwan soɔ no,
ɔbɛhwe ɔno ara amena mu,
na pɛyɛfoɔ bɛdi adepa.
11Onipa defoɔ yɛ n’ani so nyansafoɔ,
na mmɔborɔni nhunumufoɔ hwehwɛ ne mu.
12 # Mmb 11.10-11 Teneneefoɔ di ahurisie a, ɛyɛ fɛ pii,
na abɔnefoɔ deɛ wɔsɔre a, nnipa hunta.
13 # Dwom 32.3-5; 1 Yoh 1.8-9 Deɛ ɔkata ne mmarato soɔ no, ɔrenyɛ prɔmprɔm,
na deɛ ɔka na ɔgyaeɛ no, wɔbɛhu no mmɔbɔ.
14Nhyira ne onipa a ɔfɛre adeɛ daa daa,
na deɛ ɔhyɛ n’akoma den bɛtɔ bɔne mu.
15Ɔbɔnefoɔ a ɔdi ɔman mmɔborɔfoɔ soɔ
te sɛ gyata a ɔbobom ne sisire a n’ani abereɛ.
16Ɔhene a ɔnni nhunumu na ne nhyɛsoɔ so,
na deɛ ɔtane amimdie ma ne nna kyɛ.
17 # Gye 4.14 Onipa a obi mogya ho so da ne soɔ no,
ɔbɛdwane akɔduru amena mu,
mma wɔnnsianka no.
18Deɛ ɔnam pɛyɛ mu no bɛnya nkwa,
na deɛ ɔkyea akwan mmienu mu no bɛhwe baako mu.
19 # Mmb 6.6-11; 10.4; 12.11 Deɛ ɔdɔ n’asase no, aduane bɛmee no,
na deɛ ɔdi ade hunu akyire no, ohia bɛmee no.
20 # Mmb 28.22; 20.21 Onipa nokwafoɔ nhyira bɛdɔɔso,
na deɛ ɔrepɛ ntɛm anya ne ho renyɛ tɔtorɔtɔɔ.
21Animhwɛ nyɛ,
nso aduane afono ma so mpo na onipa bɛdi asɛmmɔne.
22 # Mmb 28.20; 23.4; 1 Ti 6.9 Oniberefoɔ pere ahonya ho,
na ɔnhunu sɛ ɔhia bɛba ne so.
23Deɛ ɔka obi anim no, akyire yi,
ɔbɛnya animuonyam asene deɛ ɔde ne tɛkyerɛma dɛfɛdɛfɛ.
24 # Mat 15.5 Deɛ ɔfom n’agya ne ne na adeɛ fa na ɔka sɛ:
Ɛnyɛ mmarato! no yɛ ɔdesɛefoɔ adamfo.
25Deɛ n’akɔnnɔ so hwanyan ntɔkwa,
na deɛ ɔde ne ho to AWURADE soɔ no deɛ wɔbɛdɔre sradeɛ.
26 # Mmb 3.5 Deɛ ne ho da n’akoma soɔ no yɛ ɔkwasea,
na deɛ ɔnam nyansa mu no bɛnya adwaneyɛ.
27 # 2 Ko 9.6, 9 Deɛ ɔma ohiani no, ɛrenhia no,
na deɛ ɔyi n’ani no bɛnya nnuabɔ pii.
28 # Mmb 29.2 Abɔnefoɔ sɔre a, nnipa hunta,
na wɔyera a, na teneneefoɔ redɔɔso.

Abɔnefoɔ dwane berɛ obi mpamo wɔn,
na teneneefoɔ deɛ, wɔyɛ nnam sɛ gyataburuwa.
Asase mmarato na ɛma ɛso ahemfo dɔɔso,
na nnipa nhunumufoɔ ne nimdefoɔ
na ɛma ɔhene kyɛreɛ.
Ohiani a ɔhyɛ ohiani soɔ
te sɛ osuo a ɛpra adeɛ korɔ a ɛmma aduane mma.
Wɔn a wɔgya mmara no yi ɔbɔnefoɔ ayɛ,
na wɔn a wɔdi mmara soɔ no ne wɔn di aperepereɛ.
Nnipa bɔne nhunu atemmuo mu,
na wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ AWURADE akyiri kwan no hunu ade nyinaa mu.
Ohiani a ɔnam ne pɛyɛ mu yɛ
sene deɛ ɔkyea akwan mmienu mu na wanya ne ho.
Deɛ ɔbu mmara no yɛ ɔba nyansafoɔ,
na deɛ ɔne ahohwifoɔ bɔ no hyɛ n’agya aniwuo.
Deɛ ɔde mfɛntom ne apempensie dɔre n’adeɛ no,
ɔboaboa ano ma deɛ ɔbɛhunu mmɔborɔfoɔ mmɔborɔ.
Deɛ ɔyi n’aso firi mmara tie ho no,
ne mpaebɔ mpo yɛ akyiwadeɛ.
Deɛ ɔgyegye teefoɔ kɔ bɔne kwan soɔ no,
ɔbɛhwe ɔno ara amena mu,
na pɛyɛfoɔ bɛdi adepa.
Onipa defoɔ yɛ n’ani so nyansafoɔ,
na mmɔborɔni nhunumufoɔ hwehwɛ ne mu.
Teneneefoɔ di ahurisie a, ɛyɛ fɛ pii,
na abɔnefoɔ deɛ wɔsɔre a, nnipa hunta.
Deɛ ɔkata ne mmarato soɔ no, ɔrenyɛ prɔmprɔm,
na deɛ ɔka na ɔgyaeɛ no, wɔbɛhu no mmɔbɔ.
Nhyira ne onipa a ɔfɛre adeɛ daa daa,
na deɛ ɔhyɛ n’akoma den bɛtɔ bɔne mu.
Ɔbɔnefoɔ a ɔdi ɔman mmɔborɔfoɔ soɔ
te sɛ gyata a ɔbobom ne sisire a n’ani abereɛ.
Ɔhene a ɔnni nhunumu na ne nhyɛsoɔ so,
na deɛ ɔtane amimdie ma ne nna kyɛ.
Onipa a obi mogya ho so da ne soɔ no,
ɔbɛdwane akɔduru amena mu,
mma wɔnnsianka no.
Deɛ ɔnam pɛyɛ mu no bɛnya nkwa,
na deɛ ɔkyea akwan mmienu mu no bɛhwe baako mu.
Deɛ ɔdɔ n’asase no, aduane bɛmee no,
na deɛ ɔdi ade hunu akyire no, ohia bɛmee no.
Onipa nokwafoɔ nhyira bɛdɔɔso,
na deɛ ɔrepɛ ntɛm anya ne ho renyɛ tɔtorɔtɔɔ.
Animhwɛ nyɛ,
nso aduane afono ma so mpo na onipa bɛdi asɛmmɔne.
Oniberefoɔ pere ahonya ho,
na ɔnhunu sɛ ɔhia bɛba ne so.
Deɛ ɔka obi anim no, akyire yi,
ɔbɛnya animuonyam asene deɛ ɔde ne tɛkyerɛma dɛfɛdɛfɛ.
Deɛ ɔfom n’agya ne ne na adeɛ fa na ɔka sɛ:
Ɛnyɛ mmarato! no yɛ ɔdesɛefoɔ adamfo.
Deɛ n’akɔnnɔ so hwanyan ntɔkwa,
na deɛ ɔde ne ho to AWURADE soɔ no deɛ wɔbɛdɔre sradeɛ.
Deɛ ne ho da n’akoma soɔ no yɛ ɔkwasea,
na deɛ ɔnam nyansa mu no bɛnya adwaneyɛ.
Deɛ ɔma ohiani no, ɛrenhia no,
na deɛ ɔyi n’ani no bɛnya nnuabɔ pii.
Abɔnefoɔ sɔre a, nnipa hunta,
na wɔyera a, na teneneefoɔ redɔɔso.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
